prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 766px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较重点城市各季度GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的经济表现。","reading":"读者沿行查看同一城市的季度变化和说明，也会沿列比较各城市在同一季度的增速；说明文字较长，很可能主导各数据行的高度。","groups":["第一列城市名称用于定位整行。","第二至第五列都是季度增速，承担相同的比较功能，宜保持一致的视觉权重。","第六列说明为各城市的数值提供背景，与同一行的数据共同阅读。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称","季度增速数值及其小数点","百分号"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文叙述可自然换行，并利用说明文字形成的行高。","季度子表头可换行，但应保持四个季度一致的处理方式。","跨四列的季度增速总表头在必要时可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [52, 43, 43, 44, 43, 134] · table 360×1105px · row heights [36, 83, 199, 176, 153, 153, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"城市名称和季度数值完整，四个季度宽度接近，便于沿行和沿列比较。说明列获得了相对较多的空间，长叙述能够自然换行，表格也保持在视口内。","problems":"四个季度子表头都被排成三个单字纵列，表头显得高而拥挤，季度名称也不易快速辨认。说明文字行长较短，形成很高的数据行；数值只占行首一小部分，下面留下大片空白，削弱了横向比较的节奏。","cause":"季度列只有43–44px，扣除21px后仅余22–23px，放不下两个汉字；说明列134px扣除内边距后为113px，仍需将长叙述折成多行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"two-character-quarters","widths":[52,51,51,51,51,103],"change":"将四个季度列统一加宽到51px，使每列有30px容纳两个汉字，争取让季度表头一致地分成两行；城市列保持完整。说明列缩至103px，用更长的数据行换取更清楚的季度表头和更均衡的数值区。"},{"name":"balanced","widths":[52,47,47,47,47,119],"change":"四个季度列统一为47px，增加数值周围的余量并保持一致节奏；说明列保留119px。用于检验在表头仍可能逐字换行的情况下，是否能改善整体比例。"},{"name":"notes-first","widths":[51,43,43,43,43,136],"change":"将城市列缩至仍可容纳两字城市名的51px，四个季度列统一为43px，把节省的空间交给说明列。保留紧凑的数值区，检验略宽的说明文字是否能改善行高和阅读节奏。"}]}
